description: Free: replaces a lost domain token using the l402 proof or cashu token the domain's registration or transfer was paid with. The old token stops working. Works while the domain is registered here, unless an account owns it (its owner uses token_rotate) or the registrant changed since.

cashu.description: The cashu token this domain's order was paid with.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. example.com (an offered TLD: info, domains.tlds).

l402.description: The '<macaroon>:<preimage>' this domain's order was paid with.
